STRUCTURAL_MATRIX_CLASS_ID_ONLY.proves: The policy class exists and is assigned to one evidence group only.
STRUCTURAL_MATRIX_CLASS_ID_ONLY.does_not_prove: No class-specific Draft output, typed rejection or V1-versus-V8 parity is proved.

FINANCE_V8_20_VARIANT_MATRIX.proves: Current V8 reaches POST_CREATE_REFRESH with exact finance item, amount, VAT, PAYE treatment, channel, allocation, reservation, case state, snapshots and breakdown assertions for the selected variant ordinals.
FINANCE_V8_20_VARIANT_MATRIX.does_not_prove: The runner does not execute V1 or produce a typed V1-versus-V8 result manifest.

ORDINARY_V8_8_CASE_MATRIX.proves: Current V8 reaches POST_CREATE_REFRESH on PostgreSQL 17.11 and 18.6 with exact selected component multiset, constituent-to-allocation-to-item links, amount, channel, VAT, Timesheet snapshot and item-breakdown assertions for each named case.
ORDINARY_V8_8_CASE_MATRIX.does_not_prove: The runner does not execute historical V1. Saved resolution classes are proved by their separate current-owner writer-to-finalizer matrix.

SAVED_RESOLUTION_V8_2_CASE_MATRIX.proves: On PostgreSQL 17.11 and 18.6 the current writer's saved conversion evidence is consumed through the current V8 finalizer while the separate existing recovery headroom owner still controls the final Draft recovery amount.
SAVED_RESOLUTION_V8_2_CASE_MATRIX.does_not_prove: The runner does not execute historical V1 and does not permit the saved converted amount to replace the current-pay-run recovery cap.

PRIOR_EXCLUSION_V8_12_CLASS_MATRIX.proves: On PostgreSQL 17.11 and 18.6 the 12 prior-paid, reservation, supersession, cancellation-return, snooze and exclusion classes each pass for PAYE and Umbrella with exact current-V8 output or typed zero-write rejection.
PRIOR_EXCLUSION_V8_12_CLASS_MATRIX.does_not_prove: The fixture does not execute historical V1; excluded classes are successful fail-closed policy proofs, not Draft outputs.

SIGNED_RECOVERY_V8_5_CASE_MATRIX.proves: On PostgreSQL 17.11 and 18.6 current V8 finalises the exact positive return, paired negative recovery and mixed ordinary same-key shape, while duplicate decisive and tampered/incomplete evidence fail typed with zero additional item, allocation or reservation rows.
SIGNED_RECOVERY_V8_5_CASE_MATRIX.does_not_prove: The runner does not execute historical V1 and does not turn typed fail-closed negative cases into successful Draft outputs.

PAIRED_V8_11_CLASS_MATRIX.proves: Nine paired-Timesheet classes have exact current-V8 Draft output or typed zero-write rejection on PostgreSQL 17.11 and 18.6. The two reversal-only classes prove the current correction-chain owner maps the complete negative residual to the existing overpayment-recovery handoff; combined with the separate finance-headroom matrix, a standalone reversal with zero positive-pay headroom is retained but excluded from that Draft while exact and partial headroom remain governed by the existing recovery owner. The matrix also proves positive-only is invalid and source-binds the current atomic two-member delete behavior.
PAIRED_V8_11_CLASS_MATRIX.does_not_prove: No historical V1 route is executed. The reversal-only result does not create a new negative Timesheet payment and does not alter recovery economics. The user-required replacement-only deletion to a republished genuine REVERSAL_ONLY unit is not implemented by the current standard delete owner and remains an explicit upstream gap.

FINANCE_LIFECYCLE_HEADROOM_V8_12_CLASS_M.proves: Twelve finance lifecycle, headroom and carry-forward classes pass across PAYE and Umbrella on PostgreSQL 17.11 and 18.6, including exact response-loss replay and typed tamper rejection.
FINANCE_LIFECYCLE_HEADROOM_V8_12_CLASS_M.does_not_prove: The fixture does not execute historical V1 or prove an installed Miget definition.

P6_BOUNDED_SCALE_REPLAY_CONCURRENCY.proves: PostgreSQL 17.11 and 18.6 accept bounded row-backed certificate transport and complete current-V8 Draft output at 101, 1,001 and 5,000 rows, including a distinct 101-Timesheet case, a separate 101-segment case, four independent Candidates, simultaneous PAYE/Umbrella partitions, exact items/allocations/breakdowns/parity rows/snapshots, response-loss replay and unchanged call budgets. Different operation keys racing for one Workbench selection are serialized to one active operation under the existing lock budget. A failure after both PAYE and Umbrella partial Draft batches exist compensates both channel batches, voids partial items and leaves no active financial/provider state while retaining truthful audit evidence. A separate rollback fixture proves a changed Workbench authority before final freeze returns WORKBENCH_CERTIFICATE_FINAL_FREEZE_STALE, preserves STAGING without partial freeze, and a later refresh cannot poison an already frozen Draft under Policy X. A scalar-only boundary proof shows exact count 50,001 is rejected by the Worker before operation start and cannot be represented by the server certificate/admission tables, with no Draft operation or partial manifest row on either engine.
P6_BOUNDED_SCALE_REPLAY_CONCURRENCY.does_not_prove: This does not materialise 50,000 rows, execute historical V1 or prove downstream Execute Payment parity.

FULL_TYPED_DRAFT_V1_V8.generated_id_rule: Map generated technical IDs only by stable business role; do not normalize money, status, type, key, membership, digest or policy output.

execution_boundary.unchanged_timeout_rule: No statement, lock or idle-in-transaction budget may be increased, removed or bypassed.

create_draft_policy_contract_conformance.scope: Exact current-V8 Draft output, typed zero-write rejection, compensated failure or scalar ceiling outcome for every frozen policy class. Downstream Execute Payment and cancellation gates remain separately measured and this status does not claim historical V1 executed all 88 classes.

pass_rule: No class may become PARITY_PASS unless an exact case selector executes both V1 and V8 and a typed result manifest proves the required assertion profile. Group membership, source text, transport proof, totals-only evidence or a current-V8-only result cannot satisfy parity.
